headline: V.S.S. Mani submits SEBI takeover exemption disclosure for Just Dial shares
hook: Promoter acquisition filing at Just Dial
summary: Promoter V.S.S. Mani has filed a regulatory disclosure regarding share acquisitions made under exemptions provided in SEBI Takeover Regulations. The filing complies with Regulation 10(6) reporting requirements for stock exchanges. Such disclosures provide transparency on internal promoter stake movements. Indian retail investors tracking Just Dial can note routine promoter holding updates.
why_it_matters: Routine promoter stake filing with no immediate impact on share price.
